question: How is an embodied stream of immortality manifested through the pretext of teeth?
premises: A stream is borne as if embodied
The stream is associated with freedom from death
Teeth serve as the apparent medium
inference: An immortal essence appears embodied, veiled under the ordinary form of teeth.
uncertainties: Exact imagery of the stream and teeth is ambiguous
plain_english: Bearing what seems an embodied stream, he shows the deathless pair under the pretext of teeth.
